title: Resident Doctors’ Stir Over Stipends Intensifies Across Jammu Kashmir

ai.summary: Postgraduate and senior resident doctors in Jammu and Kashmir intensified their protest demanding stipend revisions, implementation of the Seventh Pay Commission structure, and uniform pay scales across medical institutions, with support from district hospitals and dental colleges.

facts.claim: The agitation by postgraduate and senior resident doctors across Jammu and Kashmir over stipend enhancement, pay disparities and implementation of the Seventh Pay Commission intensified on Wednesday
facts.quote: The agitation by postgraduate and senior resident doctors across Jammu and Kashmir over stipend enhancement, pay disparities and implementation of the Seventh Pay Commission intensified on Wednesday

facts.claim: The protest entered its seventh consecutive day at Government Medical College (GMC) Jammu and sixth day at GMC Srinagar
facts.quote: The protest entered its seventh consecutive day at Government Medical College (GMC) Jammu and sixth day at GMC Srinagar

facts.claim: Residents of Government Dental College (GDC) Srinagar have also joined the agitation, seeking revision of stipends for Master of Dental Surgery (MDS) doctors
facts.quote: Residents of Government Dental College (GDC) Srinagar have also joined the agitation, seeking revision of stipends for Master of Dental Surgery (MDS) doctors

facts.claim: Dr Danish Hamid, dental representative from GMC Jammu and Dental Head of the All India Medical Students Association (AIMSA), said dental doctors were united with their medical counterparts in demanding a common stipend enhancement for MD, MS, DNB and MDS residents
facts.quote: Dr Danish Hamid, dental representative from GMC Jammu and Dental Head of the All India Medical Students Association (AIMSA), said dental doctors were united with their medical counterparts in demanding a common stipend enhancement for MD, MS, DNB and MDS residents

facts.claim: Postgraduate residents Dr Sanah Javaid and Dr Abhishek Mittal called for the replacement of the existing Sixth Pay Commission structure with the Seventh Pay Commission for resident doctors in Jammu and Kashmir
facts.quote: Postgraduate residents Dr Sanah Javaid and Dr Abhishek Mittal called for the replacement of the existing Sixth Pay Commission structure with the Seventh Pay Commission for resident doctors in Jammu and Kashmir

facts.claim: The movement is also gaining support from peripheral healthcare institutions, with doctors from District Hospital Kulgam, District Hospital Ganderbal and Sub-District Hospital Kupwara scheduled to join the protesters at JLNM Hospital, Rainawari, in the coming days
facts.quote: The movement is also gaining support from peripheral healthcare institutions, with doctors from District Hospital Kulgam, District Hospital Ganderbal and Sub-District Hospital Kupwara scheduled to join the protesters at JLNM Hospital, Rainawari, in the coming days

facts.claim: Dr Yaser Fayaz, a postgraduate resident at District Hospital Kulgam, said doctors from the hospital would visit JLNM Hospital to express solidarity with their protesting colleagues
facts.quote: Dr Yaser Fayaz, a postgraduate resident at District Hospital Kulgam, said doctors from the hospital would visit JLNM Hospital to express solidarity with their protesting colleagues

facts.claim: PG residents at JLNM Hospital, Dr Ravi and Dr Zoha Suzain, said resident doctors working in district hospitals across Jammu and Kashmir, including Diplomate of National Board (DNB) doctors, were extending full support to the movement
facts.quote: PG residents at JLNM Hospital, Dr Ravi and Dr Zoha Suzain, said resident doctors working in district hospitals across Jammu and Kashmir, including Diplomate of National Board (DNB) doctors, were extending full support to the movement

facts.claim: The protesters are seeking an end to disparities in stipends across institutions, revision of monthly payments and implementation of the Seventh Pay Commission structure
facts.quote: The protesters are seeking an end to disparities in stipends across institutions, revision of monthly payments and implementation of the Seventh Pay Commission structure

ai.background_note: Doctors in Jammu and Kashmir are protesting for stipend revisions, implementation of the Seventh Pay Commission structure, and uniform pay scales across medical institutions, with support from district hospitals and dental colleges.
